records.claim: Router Gateway is a non-privileged offline-first module integrated into the existing Windows/Linux app; it provides router configuration data and does not blindly mutate router firmware.
L2TP/IPsec is preferred; PPTP is explicit legacy fallback.
VPN Gate L2TP/IPsec uses vpn/vpn and PSK vpn; numeric IP can be used where hostname resolution is filtered.
VPNBook PPTP snapshot uses vpnbook plus rotating password; refresh is best-effort and snapshot is labeled rotating.
Public endpoint DNS resolving to non-global address is treated as DNS interception/private and cannot pass reachability.
Linux deterministic packaging normalizes JSON EOL in addition to prior text types.
v1.3.0 is based on authoritative v1.2.1 tag/commit after detecting concurrent origin/main movement; pre-rebase v1.3 artifact hashes are superseded.
Final Windows payload/service/manifest and installer gates PASS; final WPF UI automation PASS with 8 profiles and fail-closed DNS interception.
Linux contract/runtime smoke PASS and Linux ZIP reproduces byte-identically on Windows and Linux.
Full authenticated L2TP/IPsec/PPTP handshake on a specific physical router was not performed.
records.reason: Router model/firmware is not specified and automatic router mutation is intentionally out of scope.
